name: OTEL LGTM
description: An OpenTelemetry Backend in a Docker Image.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
# Service definitions for big-bear-otel-lgtm application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-otel-lgtm
  # The `big-bear-otel-lgtm` service definition
  big-bear-otel-lgtm:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-otel-lgtm
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: grafana/otel-lgtm:0.38.0@sha256:75cdf892daffadf3763ef61c16a6d7f8586216fce0b40bba7874a0b053121084
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      # Mounting the local otel-lgtm_data directory to /data inside the container
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data:/data
    # Ports mapping between host and container
    ports:
      # Mapping port 3000 of the host to port 3000 of the container
      - mode: ingress
        target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      # Mapping port 4317 of the host to port 4317 of the container  
      - mode: ingress
        target: 4317
        published: "4317"
        protocol: tcp
      # Mapping port 4318 of the host to port 4318 of the container  
      - mode: ingress
        target: 4318
        published: "4318"
        protocol: tcp
    # Networks to be attached to the container
    networks:
      - big-bear-otel-lgtm
networks:
  big-bear-otel-lgtm:
    driver: bridge
